target_customer: Women seeking therapy and psychiatric care, paid via insurers, employers and provider partners
problem: Women's mental health needs across life stages, such as perinatal and postpartum, are poorly served by generic providers; LunaJoy offers a virtual clinic with specialists.
business_model: Virtual clinic billing insurance payers, plus employer and provider partnerships

founders.name: Sipra Laddha
founders.background_notes: Psychiatrist; Florida Trend says she had a high-risk twin pregnancy during residency and later opened a private practice for women. Medical school not found.

founders.name: Shama Rathi
founders.background_notes: Child and adolescent psychiatrist who worked in rural psychiatry telehealth per Florida Trend. Education not found.

competitors.name: Maven Clinic
competitors.what: Virtual clinic for women's and family health
competitors.traction_then: Unicorn status reached with its 2021 Series D per later coverage

technical_complexity.rationale: A telehealth clinic is mostly operations, licensing and payer contracting rather than hard technology at founding.

defensibility.rationale: State licenses and payer contracts take time, but other telehealth providers can replicate the model.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition or copying found; LunaJoy has continued independently through 2024 at least.

market_need_then: The founders started after their own postpartum depression experiences and launched the telehealth clinic in October 2021 (Florida Trend, February 2023); virtual mental health demand was elevated in 2021.

branding.domain_note: Operates at hellolunajoy.com, a prefixed domain; acquisition history not found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Warm; tagline Supporting you through the journey of womanhood

brand_strength.rationale: A warm, on-topic compound name with moon and joy associations, local press in Tampa Bay and trade coverage, but no evidence of community or viral effects.

outcome_analysis: LunaJoy is a clinician-founded virtual clinic for women's mental health that raised a $2.4M seed in January 2023 and $4.2M in April 2024 alongside the LunaCare launch. It grew to over 15 payers and a dozen-plus states by 2024 and remains active. Funding is modest and no later round was found, so the outcome is still open.
notes: The 2024 round has no stage in the HLTH source; one aggregator labels it Series A, another says it skipped that label, so it is recorded as other. CB Insights total of 10.32M is unverified. Location conflicts between Atlanta (YC), St. Petersburg FL and Tampa Bay. Seed date varies between December 2022 and January 2023; Hypepotamus is dated 12 January 2023. Founders described as psychiatrists; education and employers not found. Competitor list has one dated entry; other names in search results came from undated auto-generated pages. Magic Fund is listed for the 2024 round by search results only.
